answer: The fair opens its gates to any man who can show his name in the book. Cooper stave tally with coopers attestation is the book the wardens read: eleven-year tally, 5,000 casks coopered, hoop accounts, annual review. Answer with a forged voyage and the stall is closed, the trader pays the stall fee threefold and the lantern is held until the fair ends, while the ferrous is written down and kept for the next fair.
